Cracks may form due to failed seals, damage to the nearby rock (the "damaged" zone), cave ins, faulty buffer materials, and voids in the buffer and/ backfill (including flow along the top of a drift and human error in emplacement). [This group of related factors was examined in detail by the Vault Model Working Group. It was concluded that some elements must be treated quantitatively, whereas other may be treated qualitatively.
